propositions: Project criteria activated via _project_criteria are evaluated during probe mode despite being outside the E4/G1G2 allowlist, incurring unnecessary billable LLM calls.
The probe allowlist is available as gate input probe_criteria but is not threaded to the batch step, causing project criteria to bypass probe filtering.
_project_criteria must accept a probe allowlist parameter and filter returned project criteria to only ids present in the allowlist.
The probe_criteria input must be passed through BatchRunRequest.with_inputs to the batch step without adding plan-review-specific fields to the generic BatchRunRequest dataclass.
Monkeypatched stubs of _project_criteria in tests must accept the new third parameter to prevent TypeError when the call site passes the probe allowlist.
